info.title: Gamesight Reporting API
info.description: The Gamesight Reporting API lets you programmatically pull Marketing Analytics data — campaign stats, goals, games, trackers, user-level events and touchpoints, and audit logs — into your data warehouse or BI systems. Authorize with a Reporting, Aggregate Reporting, or GDPR scoped API key via the Authorization header.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: This should be an API Key with the Advertiser scope

parameters.name: X-Api-Version
parameters.description: Note that you must pass a version 3 header to get this API

game_id.description: The ID of the Game to pull reporting for

fields.description: Fields set the list of metrics returned. See the full list of supported fields [here](#fields).

groups.description: Groups set the dimensions returned from the report. See the full list of supported groups [here](#groups).

filters.description: List of filters to restrict the results

start_triggered_at_date.description: Start of the date range to run the report over

end_triggered_at_date.description: End of the date range to run the report over

goal_type_ids.description: List of goal types to restrict results to include

include_unattributed.description: Set to True to include a row in the response for unattributed goals.

timezone.description: Timezone to adjust all reported dates/times into. Reference for supported formats [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones).

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: This should be an API Key with the Advertiser scope

start_datetime.description: Pull goals triggered after this time (inclusive)

end_datetime.description: Pull goals triggered before this time (exclusive)

goal_type_ids.description: Restrict the results to the provided goal types

trigger_types.description: Restrict the results to the provided trigger types (standard, assist, contribution)

unattributed.description: Restrict the results to only include unattributed (True), attributed (False), or all (Null)

limit.description: Limit the number of results per page. Max 1,000,000 results per page

after.description: Pull the page starting with this page token

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: This should be an API Key with the Advertiser scope

parameters.name: with_names
parameters.description: Pass `true` to include Tracker names in the response, defaults to `false`

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Pass a limit to restrict the number of results in the API response. Returns all trackers by default

parameters.name: after_shortcode
parameters.description: Pass a tracker shortcode to page through Trackers, results are ordered by shortcode. Use in combination with limit for pagination.

parameters.name: updated_after
parameters.description: Pass to filter results to only include Trackers that were updated after the specified timestamp

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: This should be an API Key with the Advertiser scope

team_id.description: Team ID to place the tracker in

cost_model.description: cpc will add cost_amount spend for every click recorded, cpm for every 1000 impressions

cost_amount.description: Decimal number passed as a string

destination_url.description: Destination to redirect the user to when they click on this Tracker

referral_code.description: Referral code to be attached to this Tracker

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: This should be an API Key with the Advertiser scope

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: Org ID for the Organization to pull audit logs from

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: API Key with the `org_audit` scope to be used for pulling logs

parameters.name: start_datetime
parameters.description: Start of the time range to pull logs from, inclusive. ISO 8601 format, UTC.

parameters.name: end_datetime
parameters.description: End of the time range to pull audit logs from, inclusive. ISO 8601 format, UTC.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Min: 1, Max: 500

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor
